mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, return_quantity, unit_price, subtotal) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, 0, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotal})

INSERT INTO sales_order_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, return_quantity, unit_price, subtotal) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, 0, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.subtotal})
mapper.select: SELECT soi.*, p.name AS product_name, p.specification, un.name AS unit_name FROM sales_order_item soi LEFT JOIN product p ON soi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN unit un ON p.unit_id = un.id WHERE soi.order_id = #{orderId}

mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order_item SET return_quantity = #{returnQuantity} WHERE id = #{id}
